context.transcript:
Would you like to go on a camping trip but don't have the
right supplies? Grove Emporium is here to help. Right now
during our year-end clearance event you can get incredible
deals on new tents, sleeping bags, and other items. In
addition, a portion of the proceeds will go towards repairing
hiking trails at our local nature center. Our Greenville store
location will not be participating in the sale this year because
it's closed for renovations, so this sales event is taking place
exclusively at our Town Square location. Take advantage of
the great prices at Grove Emporium today.
context.transcript_translation: 您想去露营，却没有合适的装备吗？格罗夫百货可以帮您。现在正值年终清仓活动，您可以以超值价格购买新帐篷、睡袋和其他用品。此外，部分销售收入将用于修复当地自然中心的徒步小径。我们的格林维尔门店因停业翻修，今年不参加促销，因此本次销售活动仅在城市广场门店举行。今天就到格罗夫百货享受优惠价格吧。
